claims.text: Jayesh Patel is the current CEO of Wio Bank.
Jayesh Patel was confirmed as CEO of Wio Bank around February 2022, following the Central Bank of the UAE's in-principle license approval to Wio.
Jayesh Patel has been CEO of Wio Bank 'since December 2020.'
Wio Bank is owned by four shareholders: ADQ and Alpha Dhabi (combined 65%), Etisalat/e& (25%), and First Abu Dhabi Bank (10%).
Wio Bank is owned solely by 'the investment and holding company Abu Dhabi Holding.'
Wio Bank's total invested capital at launch was AED 2.3 billion.
Before Wio, Jayesh Patel was Head of Liv. Digital Bank at Emirates NBD.
claims.corroboration_caveat: All four sources plausibly trace back to the same subject-supplied career bio rather than independent reporting.

claims.text: Before Emirates NBD, Jayesh Patel was Assistant Director, Strategic Planning and Performance Management at Qatar Telecom.
claims.corroboration_caveat: Both sources plausibly trace back to the same subject-supplied career bio.

claims.text: Jayesh Patel holds an MBA from the Tuck School of Business at Dartmouth.
Jayesh Patel holds a Master of Science in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (2001).
Jayesh Patel holds a degree in Civil Engineering from Southern Illinois University Edwardsville.
In FY2023, Wio Bank reported revenue of AED 266.4 million and net profit of AED 2 million, becoming profitable in its first full year.
claims.corroboration_caveat: Figures are attributed to a direct quote from Patel in a single media interview, not to a published audited financial statement or CBUAE filing.
